style.name: Pixar/Disney-style 3D animation
style.description: warm, wholesome Christian kids' cartoon, soft rounded shapes, big expressive friendly faces, gentle and reverent, family-friendly
style.rendering: high-detail subsurface skin, soft cinematic global illumination, shallow depth of field, 24fps feature-film feel
style.palette: brand royal-blue, sunny gold, warm cream, soft heavenly light
style.audio: gentle uplifting orchestral score, soft acoustic guitar, light playful percussion, warm natural ambience; reverent and never scary
style.negative: subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands, warped anatomy, flickering, morphing character, inconsistent character design, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, duplicate characters, extra people, scary imagery, violence, blood, dark or frightening tone

characters.name: TyGuy
characters.role: host / big-brother mentor (consistent lead, every episode)
characters.appearance: a cheerful 3D cartoon young man, early 20s, warm tan skin, short dark-brown hair, big friendly brown eyes, bright kind smile
characters.wardrobe: royal-blue hoodie with a white letter 'T' on the chest, dark jeans, white sneakers
characters.voice: warm, upbeat, encouraging young-adult male voice
characters.personality: kind, patient, joyful, gently teaches Scripture by example
characters.consistent: ALWAYS the same: face shape, dark-brown hair, royal-blue 'T' hoodie, brown eyes — never change his design or outfit

characters.name: Kelliee
characters.appearance: a bright, bubbly 3D cartoon girl, age 10, light-brown skin, curly auburn hair in two puff pigtails, big hazel eyes, freckles
characters.wardrobe: sunny-yellow hoodie with a small white cross on the chest, teal leggings, white-and-pink sneakers
characters.voice: cheerful, curious, slightly higher-energy young girl voice
characters.personality: eager and warm-hearted, asks the questions kids are thinking, sometimes reacts first and learns the lesson
characters.consistent: ALWAYS the same: auburn puff pigtails, yellow cross hoodie, freckles, hazel eyes — never change her design or outfit
